themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 4 champion buffs, 7 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: The World Championship has gotten a whole lot more spookier. Structured changes across 13 entities this patch.

champions.name: Akali
champions.tldr: New Effect: Now applies true sight instead of a standard reveal.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akali is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.
